name: Conception Miraculous
overview: Scripture reveals that miraculous conception is a sovereign act of God, as seen when He fulfilled His promise to Sarah by enabling her to conceive in old age at the appointed time (Genesis 21:1-2). Similarly, Hannah's prayer was answered when the Lord remembered her and granted her a son, Samuel (1 Samuel 1:19-20). The account of Elizabeth also demonstrates God's gracious intervention, as she conceived and rejoiced in the removal of her reproach (Luke 1:24-25). These passages affirm that God alone controls the gift of life, fulfilling His purposes through miraculous births.
